title: Organizations
intro_text: Organizations are internal community groups. They are not external legal types. Each community defines its own types according to its needs.
mine_intro: These are the organizations where you have a role (board or membership). You can work in them: view wallet, manage, transfer according to your permissions.
all_intro: All organizations on the node. You can view them but can only act in those where you have a role. Click one to see its public information.
form_user_help: Select the existing user that will represent this organization. Search by username or display name.
form_name_hint: Organization name. Ex: North Cooperative, United Bakery
form_type_hint: Select the organization type according to its function within the community.
form_tax_hint: Tax percentage that applies to this organization's transactions.
form_credit_limit_hint: Maximum amount the organization can have as credit (negative balance allowed).
form_debit_limit_hint: Maximum amount the organization can have as debit (positive balance allowed).
form_new_type_hint: Add a custom type if the predefined ones do not cover your community's needs.
no_membership: You are not a member of any organization yet.
no_membership_hint: When you are assigned to the board of an organization, it will appear here.
no_organizations: There are no organizations on this node.
type_commission_desc: Temporary group for a specific task
departments_no_depts_hint: Departments are community work areas. Create the first one with the button above.
departments_no_permission: You do not have permission to create departments. Ask the administrator to do it.
departments_modal_name_hint: Name of the work area. Should be clear and descriptive. Example: "Production", "Distribution", "Administration".
departments_modal_desc_placeholder: Ex: In charge of producing food
departments_modal_desc_hint: Briefly explain what this department is for and its responsibilities. Example: "In charge of producing food for the community".
departments_modal_belongs_hint: Every department must belong to an organization or the node's Assembly. It cannot exist isolated or belong to a person.
departments_modal_role_name_hint: Name of the role within the department. Example: "Coordinator", "Member", "Treasurer".
departments_modal_role_desc_hint: Describe the responsibilities of this role. Example: "Coordinates department activities and supervises members".
departments_modal_user_hint: You can only assign registered members of the node.
departments_modal_role_hint: What role this person will have in the department. The role determines their permissions. Example: "Coordinator", "Member".
dept_detail_no_roles: No roles. Create the first one with the button above.
dept_detail_no_members: No members. Assign the first one with the button above.
dept_detail_transfer_hint: To transfer to this department, use @{{username}} as recipient.
dept_detail_no_transactions: There are no transactions in this account.
